title: Lead QA Automation Engineer (PlayWright)
description:
### **Position Overview:**

We are looking for a Lead QA Automation Engineer (Playwright) to lead QA strategy, automation framework development, and testing for enterprise Web, Mobile, API, Retail, and POS applications. The role requires strong hands-on expertise in Playwright, Appium, API testing, programming, CI/CD, and database validation, along with experience in QA leadership and team mentoring. The candidate will also drive the practical use of Generative AI tools, especially Claude, to improve test automation, coverage, debugging, and maintenance.  
  
ShyftLabs is a growing data product company founded in early 2020 and works primarily with Fortune 500 companies. We deliver digital solutions built to help accelerate the growth of businesses in various industries, by focusing on creating value through innovation.

### **Job Responsibilities:**

Responsible for leading the quality strategy and execution of software solutions. This includes defining test strategies, governing automation frameworks, mentoring other team members, from initial planning through to final production deployment.  
Lead the automation strategy and development of automated test scripts for PetConnect (Inventory and Store order process ) and POS B&M applications  
Architect, build, and scale robust end-to-end (E2E) automation frameworks using Playwright.  
Drive the adoption and hands-on application of various generative AI tools—with a primary focus on Claude—to accelerate test case creation, map test coverage, and automated test scripts from scratch.  
Leverage AI assistants and Claude to streamline framework refactoring, optimize test code, and drastically reduce the overhead of ongoing test script maintenance and debugging.  
Partner with cross-functional teams to define scope, objectives, and deliverables for all levels of automated and manual testing.  
Establish and champion quality assurance best practices, procedures, and rigorous QA assessments.  
Spearhead Playwright best practices, including parallel test execution, multi-browser strategies (Chromium, Firefox, WebKit), and resilient element locators.  
Provide technical oversight and mentorship for existing automation frameworks.  
Track and report on metric-driven indicators of test efficiency, effectiveness, and release readiness (e.g., defect counts, code coverage, automation velocity).  
Oversee bug triage workflows, root cause analysis, and automated test code reviews prior to code commitment.  
Demonstrate exceptional communication, technical leadership, and problem-solving skills to bridge communication between business stakeholders and engineering teams.  
Drive engineering excellence across large-scale, enterprise-wide initiatives and release cycles.

### **Basic Qualifications:**

Bachelor Degree in Computer Science or equivalent  
Experience in Quality leadership experience managing complex projects related to retail, B&M, Mobile POS applications  
7+ years of experience working with Web, Mobile and API Service based applications  
Deep proficiency in validating front-end web applications, back-end web services, and microservices using tools such as Postman and SoapUI.  
7+ years of expertise working with leading automation tools and frameworks, with advanced proficiency in Playwright alongside Selenium, Cypress, RestAssured, PyTest, Robot, and BDD/TDD paradigms.  
Extensive, hands-on experience leveraging various AI tools and Claude specifically within day-to-day QA workflows—proven ability to utilize AI for intelligent test generation, script acceleration, framework construction, and automated maintenance.  
5+ years of experience working with Appium and such related tools for Mobile automation  
Strong fluency in modern programming languages, with 5+ years working in TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, or Java.  
Expertise in version control workflows and governance using Git, GitHub, and GitLab.  
Proven track record of configuring continuous integration/deployment (CI/CD) pipelines and test scheduling via tools like Jenkins.  
Proficiency in backend database querying and validation using Oracle and SQL tools.  
3+ years of experience with Agile development practices, scrum and supporting apps like JIRA  
Experience with test management tools like TestRail, Zephyr, HP ALM  
Outstanding debugging, troubleshooting, and analytical capabilities for complex automated architectures.  
Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with a proven ability to lead technical discussions and mentor teams.

*ShyftLabs is an equal-opportunity employer committed to creating a safe, diverse, and inclusive environment. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds including ethnicity, religion, disability status, gender identity, sexual orientation, family status, age, and nationality to apply. If you require accommodation during the interview process, let us know and we’ll be happy to support you.*

title: Senior Control Automation Engineer
description:
The Senior Control Automation System Engineer is responsible for leading the design, implementation, integration, and validation of HVDC Control & Protection systems. This role works across engineering disciplines and supports solution development, project execution, product care, and tendering activities. The engineer will provide technical leadership, drive consistent design practices, mentor engineering teams, and ensure solutions meet customer, business, and compliance requirements.

**Job Description**
===================

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Lead the technical solution for customer requirements based on the reference design.

* Define, develop, integrate, and validate HVDC SCADA/HMI and Control & Protection systems.

* Own the overall design and architecture of the control system, communication networks, and cybersecurity implementation.

* Ability to define and lead HMI/SCADA integration testing at vendor and supplier premises

* Lead IEC 61850 implementation, system configuration, testing, integration, and deployment.

* Develop and review network architecture, including Layer 2/3 communication, security, and hardening requirements.

* Provide technical guidance for requirement analysis, design, implementation, and troubleshooting.

* Review and approve design documents to ensure quality, compliance, and on-time delivery.

* Support customer interface, technical discussions, and training activities.

* Mentor and coach engineering talent and promote consistent global engineering practices.

* Continuously improve product delivery speed, reliability, and stability.

* Ensure cybersecurity and compliance standards are embedded in design decisions.

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams across NPI, ITO, OTR, and Product Care.

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Degree in Electronics/Electrical engineering or related field.

* Strong background in HMI software configuration and implementation preferably in Zenon COPA-DATA or Panorama-CODRA.

* Minimum 15 years of experience in control and protection system design.

* Extensive experience with HMI, cybersecurity implementation, virtualization, and Windows operating systems.

* Experience in functional specification, HMI design requirements, symbol design, and view specification.

* Experience in industrial communication networks, including IEC 61850 and Ethernet-based protocols.

* Strong knowledge of communication network security, hardening, and cybersecurity best practices.

* Excellent understanding of Layer 2/3 protocols such as IPv4, OSPF, LACP, DMZ, VPN, DNP, IEC, and Modbus.

* Experience in power systems, substation automation, SCADA, and digital control systems.

* Strong background in HMI/SCADA technologies, testing, integration, and installation.

  

**Desired Characteristics**

* Strong oral and written communication skills.

* Proven leadership and interpersonal skills.

* Ability to analyse complex problems and make sound technical decisions.

* Experience leading programs and projects in a complex engineering environment.

* Strong documentation, planning, and execution skills.

* Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally and independently.

* Track record of designing reliable systems that meet technical, cost, and performance targets.

* Knowledge of control and protection relay logic design.

* Experience in Substation Bay Controllers, Merging Units, and IEC 61850 IED configuration.

* Knowledge in Control Panel design (preferably as used in substation/power plant environments)

* Knowledge of communication networks Security/Hardening and Cybersecurity best practices

  

**Additional Information**
==========================

**Relocation Assistance Provided:** Yes

title: Lead AC Control Automation Engineer
description:
About GE Grid Solutions: At GE Grid Solutions we are electrifying the world with advanced grid technologies. As leaders in the energy space our goal is to accelerate the transition for a more energy efficient grid to full fill the needs of tomorrow. With a focus on growth and sustainability GE Grid Solutions plays a pivotable role in integrating Renewables onto the grid to drive to carbon neutral. In Grid Solutions we help enable the transition for a greener more reliable Grid. GE Grid Solutions has the most advanced and comprehensive product and solutions portfolio within the energy sector.
  

Job Description Summary
  

  

As a Lead AC Control Automation System Engineer, you will report to the Control \& Protection Engineering Manager and will be part of a highly motivated and dynamic team of engineers working on the requirement, design, integration, installation, and commissioning of HVDC Control \& Protection Systems.
  

  

Lead AC Control Automation Engineer scope covers design, testing and deployment support for digital control system of our HVDC substations. Our system controls and monitors the transmission of energy, to guarantee the high availability of the substation as well as to protect people and equipment.
  

Why we come to work: At GE Renewable Energy, our engineers are always up for the challenge \- and we are always driven to find the best solution. Our projects are unique and interesting, and you will need to bring a solution\-focused, positive approach to each one to do your best. Surrounded by committed, loyal colleagues, if you can dare to bring your ingenuity and desire to make an impact, you will be exposed to game\-changing, diverse projects that truly allow you to play your part in the energy transition.
  

What we offer:
  

* Working in an international team which is part of global Engineering HVDC Centre of Excellence within Grid Integration based in Stafford.
* A key role in a dynamic, international working environment with a large degree of flexibility of work agreements.
* Competitive benefits, and great development opportunities

**Job Description**
===================

  

  

**Job Description**


**Roles and Responsibilities**


As Lead Control Automation System Engineer, you will be responsible of delivering the overall technical solution that meets customer Requirements. This includes the following activities:


* Customer requirements capture and analysis.
* Definition of control system architecture for a HVDC project.
* Build and update signal list of the project.
* Define control test strategy.
* define detailed test plans and procedures and execute/lead/supervise tests execution.
* SCADA/HMI development
* Lead and support FAT tests for his/her scope.
* Collaborate with different stakeholders (Project Manager, technical experts, site team, ...) to ensure successful delivery of his/her scope of work.
* Interface with equipment supplier, monitor manufacturing of cabinets and supervise Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT)
* Participate to the investigation of technical problems and the establishment of procedures and corrective actions to avoid recurrences.
* Assist site activities relevant to the installation and commissioning of the control system.
* Prepare replies to customer comments on technical submittals in coordination with project management.
* Attend, as needed, meeting with customers/contractors/ consultants for technical discussions.
* Follow the departments standard design practices, engineering reviews and guidelines.
* Apply engineering policies and procedures.
* Support department Continuous Improvement activities.
  

**Required Qualifications**


* Degree in Electronics/Electrical/Automation engineering or related field.
* Minimum of 12\-year experience in Control system development in similar application field to HVDC: Oil\&Gas, Electrical Substations, transmission, and distribution, …
* Good understanding of Electrical systems Engineering.
* Strong knowledge about communication protocols and networks
* Working experience with IEDs (Intelligent Electronic Devices)
* Good knowledge about communication design ( Fiber Optics, Ethernet network, …)
* Knowledge about norms, standards, and technologies of Control design in electrical transmission and distribution systems: like IEC 61850
* Knowledge of HMI and Scada system
* Ability to understand Electrical drawing.
* Tools: MS office (Word, Visio, Excel),
* Technical documentation and communication skills
  

  

Languages: English


* Availability to travel \~10% of time
  

  

**Desired Qualifications**


* Knowledge in Cybersecurity
* Knowledge about HVDC stations and main components.
* Languages: English

**Additional Information**
==========================


**Relocation Assistance Provided:** Yes
